behaviour: A lab worker gives each leased unit one fresh folder under its runs folder and hands that folder to the static, test and mutation executors in place of the shared runs folder; every folder a unit cuts, the report folder included, lies inside it. The worker removes that folder once the unit is delivered, once its executor raises, and once its lease is lost or abandoned with nothing delivered, always after the unit's report and log have already been read and uploaded whole. A folder that resists removal is left for the next restart's wipe and never replaces the unit's own outcome.
seam: scripts.ci_lab.worker.Worker._unit, scripts.ci_lab.executors.static, executors.tests, executors.mutation, executors._run and executors._report
